meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 当你提出 Git 请求时,它先判定是提交、改写历史、查历史还是只看状态,再按流程操作:提交按仓库既有风格拆成原子提交,查历史用 log/blame/bisect 等并给出命令与哈希证据。没明确要求就不提交、不改写、不删除。
howto.when: 当你要求做提交,或要查某行/某段代码的改动来源(blame、bisect、reflog)时接管;普通写代码不触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先看 diff 和最近提交风格再分组

say.text: 这行代码是谁什么时候改的?
say.note: 用 blame 查并给出哈希和行号

say.text: 把这两个小修改合并进上一个提交
say.note: 用 fixup 加 autosquash,可能先跟你确认

howto.what_en: It sorts each Git request into commit, rewrite, history lookup, or status-only, then follows that flow: commits split into atomic groups in the repo's own style; history answers cite commands and hashes. It won't commit or rewrite unless asked.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a commit, or for who/when a line or string changed (blame, bisect, reflog). Plain code edits don't trigger it.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into a few atomic commits
say_en.note: Checks the diff and recent message style first

say_en.text: Who changed this line and when?
say_en.note: Runs blame and cites the hash and line

say_en.text: Squash these two tweaks into the previous commit
say_en.note: Uses fixup plus autosquash; may confirm first
